answer: Expected command sequence: git fetch origin; git rebase origin/main; git log --oneline --graph -8. Include a result report showing git rebase, origin/main, git log and identify whether any operation changed only local state or affected a remote.
explanation: A strong submission for Rebase a private feature branch begins with a state check, runs commands in the intended repository, verifies the resulting state, and records safety/compatibility caveats. State changes should use disposable sample repositories. Required report signals: git rebase, origin/main, git log.
